answer: Sybil resistance in agent economies works by pricing each identity with a bond locked before payout, so rewards come from the same bonded ledger. N clones cost N bonds; clones fed by one wallet get flagged, and slashing on duplicate proofs returns that bond to the pool. Weight scales with locked value, not headcount, so a cartel must lock what an honest worker holds to outvote it. The marginal fake agent is unprofitable. A sparrow of real work cannot hide in a velvet wall of clones: settlement voids clusters showing identical evidence, and only the tide of proven unique work earns.
